name: [🍬] Swim For Eggs!
desc:
🌊 Welcome to Swim For Eggs!

Swim into dangerous waters, steal valuable eggs, and make it back before the Guardians catch you!

🌋 NEW UPDATE: Volcano (Area 9)! A lava-red sea, new fiery eggs and the Volcano Kong guardian!
& Bug Fixes, QoL and game improvements.

🏊 Train your Speed on the Aqua Treadmill
🌊 Reach deeper seas filled with rarer eggs
🥚 Raid nests guarded by dangerous creatures
🥷 Compete with other players to steal valuable eggs
🐣 Bring eggs home and hatch them into unique pets
💰 Build your collection and earn piles of cash
🏝️ Expand your base and unlock more space for eggs
✨ Hunt for rare sizes, mutations, and legendary finds

🦈 Swim farther out: bigger seas, bigger Guardians, better rewards.

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
